description: This file defines a front-end UI component called 'FloatingCartButton' for a furniture shopping app. It uses LightningJS framework to create a floating cart button with a badge displaying the number of items in the cart, and subscribes to a store to update this count dynamically.

classes.name: FloatingCartButton
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a floating shopping cart button with cart item count badge.

methods.name: goCart
methods.description: Method to navigate to the cart page when the button is activated.
